successful_patterns.pattern: Turnover/attention level and its transforms (level, spike-vs-baseline, CV) are the strongest, most robust axis on full-A
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: turn_low IS ic 0.0895/ICIR 0.59 -> OOS 0.0797; turn_spike, turn_cv also accepted with 3/3 universes, 7/7 years; ivol was even subsumed by turn_low (corr>=0.7). But 3 accepted factors already sit near the 0.7 corr ceiling -> family is close to saturated.

successful_patterns.pattern: Tail/lottery measures (TsMax of returns, negative skew) beat plain volatility — vol factors collapse into them at dedup
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: max_eff IS 0.0832/ICIR 0.74, OOS 0.0909 (stronger OOS than IS); skew accepted; lowvol and amp_low both rejected as duplicates of max_eff. Prefer tail shape over dispersion.

successful_patterns.pattern: Price-volume agreement correlations (fade volume-confirmed rallies) give the highest ICIR signals
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: pv_corr ICIR 0.97 (best of round), OOS 0.0387; ts-rank variant and smart_flow (TsCorr(TURN,RET)) also accepted. Interaction of price and volume >> either alone.

successful_patterns.pattern: Decompose close-to-close returns into intraday and overnight legs: intraday leg carries the reversal, overnight leg is MOMENTUM (sign flip vs intuition)
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: intraday_rev subsumed rev20; overnight gaps positively predict. R2: leg idea kept paying — gap_vol (overnight-leg vol, alpha_0015) IS 0.070 -> OOS 0.085 (stronger OOS), overnight_mom60 accepted (0.042/0.035). But do NOT leg-decompose MAX: max_intraday hit corr 0.90 vs whole-return max_eff.

successful_patterns.pattern: Within-industry earnings yield (EP) is the one value signal that clears the bar
successful_patterns.evidence: R1: ep_ind IS 0.0410/ICIR 0.34, OOS 0.0176 (weakest accept, decays ~57%) but 3/3 universes and 7/7 years. Value works but thin at 10d horizon.

successful_patterns.pattern: Demeaned-rank interaction terms ((CsRank(A)-0.5)*(CsRank(B)-0.5)) mine conditional structure with near-zero correlation to both parents
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: rev_x_lowturn (alpha_0018) ICIR -0.65 IS / -0.90 OOS, max corr vs set only 0.17; max_x_spike (alpha_0019) ICIR -0.83 IS. Note the SIGN: both came out negative — names where the two bullish signals AGREE underperform; disagreement (hedged/mixed profiles) outperforms. Template is productive; try other parent pairs.

successful_patterns.pattern: Up/down semivol asymmetry is the one orthogonal vol construct
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: alpha_0016 accepted (IS 0.062/0.58, OOS 0.067/0.74, PFS 0.98) while vol_of_vol and max_intraday died at the corr gate. Downside-dominated vol earns, upside-dominated vol fades.

successful_patterns.pattern: Attention DURATION (days since turnover peak) adds liquidity info orthogonal to turnover level
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: turn_dur (alpha_0017) accepted with max set-corr only 0.47 despite 3 turnover factors already in the set; IS 0.041/0.60, OOS 0.032.

successful_patterns.pattern: Cash-flow yield (CFP) joins EP as the second value survivor and holds OOS better
successful_patterns.evidence: R2: cfp_ind (alpha_0020) IS 0.033 -> OOS 0.030 vs ep_ind's 0.041 -> 0.018. Cash-based value decays less than earnings-based.

successful_patterns.pattern: Volume-price interaction family keeps producing (3 rounds running); turnover ELASTICITY to |return| is the best construct yet
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: volresp_beta (-RegBeta(TURN_F, Abs(RET), 20), alpha_0024) IS 0.065/ICIR 0.83 (best of round), OOS 0.046/0.60, max set-corr 0.58. Volume response to moves, not volume level, isolates speculation-proneness.

successful_patterns.pattern: Self-relative (time-series) framing dodges the saturated cross-sectional turnover family
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: turn_selfrank (-TsRank(TURN_F,120), alpha_0022) IS 0.051 -> OOS 0.052, squeaked the corr gate at 0.69 vs the level factor. TS-rank reframing is a general trick, but the turnover axis is now truly full (5 factors) — stop proposing it.

successful_patterns.pattern: Extreme-day FREQUENCY complements extreme-day magnitude
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: max_freq (-TsCount(RET > 2*TsStd(RET,60), 60), alpha_0021) IS 0.047 -> OOS 0.046, corr vs max_eff only 0.49.

successful_patterns.pattern: Frequency bands are separable: weekly-band decayed intraday reversal is distinct from the monthly sum
successful_patterns.evidence: R3: rev5_decay (-DecayLinear(CLOSE/OPEN-1, 7), alpha_0023) IS 0.041 -> OOS 0.052 (OOS stronger), corr vs alpha_0011 only 0.48, near-zero 10d rank-AC (fast factor).

successful_patterns.pattern: Untested one-off data fields are the highest-yield candidate slots
successful_patterns.evidence: R4: limit_up_touch count (alpha_0031) IS 0.077/0.72 OOS 0.057 — best new factor; volume_ratio mean (alpha_0034) accepted. New fields > new transforms of old fields.

successful_patterns.pattern: Self-relative (time-series) framing dodges saturated cross-sectional families
successful_patterns.evidence: R2-R4 running: turn_selfrank, gapvol_selfrank, and amihud_selfrank (alpha_0035 — RESCUED a failed level factor, OOS 0.049 > IS) all accepted. But semivol_selfrank died at corr 0.83 vs its own level version — the trick works across constructs, not within tight ones.

successful_patterns.pattern: The MAX effect has a MIN mirror: crash days continue (momentum), lottery days revert
successful_patterns.evidence: R4: min_eff (-TsMin(RET,20), alpha_0030, direction -1: deep worst-day -> low forward return) IS -0.048 OOS -0.053, corr vs max_eff only 0.58.

successful_patterns.pattern: Systematic-share (R^2 vs bench) works with the ANTI-intuitive sign: index-coupled names outperform idiosyncratic stories
successful_patterns.evidence: R4: rsq_bench (alpha_0036, direction -1 on -corr^2 i.e. +corr^2 predicts positively) IS 0.051 OOS 0.050, max set-corr only 0.30. Plain beta and semibeta asymmetry are both dead — it's the R^2, not the slope.

successful_patterns.pattern: Lagged elasticity decorrelates from same-day elasticity; fragility (reverse regression) is separate too
successful_patterns.evidence: R4: lag_chase (TsCorr(TURN, Delay(RET,1))) corr 0.41 vs set, accepted; fragility (RegBeta(|RET|,TURN)) corr 0.64, accepted. Same-day asymmetric elasticity (volresp_asym) died at 0.74 vs volresp — direction/lag changes decorrelate, up/down splits of the same regression don't.

successful_patterns.pattern: Long-band structures survive where short bands are taken: quarterly intraday reversal and yearly volume clock
successful_patterns.evidence: R5: intr_mom60 (alpha_0045) IS 0.072 -> OOS 0.072, corr vs the 20d version only 0.54 (bands separable, 3rd confirmation); vol_clock (20d/250d volume share, alpha_0044) IS 0.056 -> OOS 0.076, strongest OOS of the whole set so far.

successful_patterns.pattern: The limit-board field family generalizes: recency, one-word boards, post-event returns, and gap/amplitude extreme frequencies all clear
successful_patterns.evidence: R5: limit_recency 0.040/0.56, one_word_cnt, post_limit_ret (OOS ICIR 0.75!), amp_burst_freq, gapdn_freq all accepted. Event count/recency/aftermath on non-return series is a productive class.

successful_patterns.pattern: Cross-quantity correlations still mint factors: attention-risk coupling, aggression-attention, 2-day-lag chase
successful_patterns.evidence: R5: attn_risk_corr (TsCorr(TURN, TsStd(RET,5),20)) 0.035/0.61; aggr_attn_corr (close-vs-vwap x turnover); lag_chase2 decorrelated further (0.38 max corr). signed_attn and mean_med_gap also in.

successful_patterns.pattern: Interaction template is now 4-for-6 (behavioral pairs)
successful_patterns.evidence: R5: ix_medrev_vr OOS ICIR -0.76 (best interaction yet), ix_limit_gapvol accepted (2/3 universes). Always negative sign: agreement between bullish behavioral signals is consistently bearish.

successful_patterns.pattern: Flow data pays through COUPLING structure, not levels: flow-return correlations mint factors
successful_patterns.evidence: R6: mf_ret_corr (-TsCorr(MF_LG_NET, RET, 20), alpha_0052) IS 0.053 -> OOS 0.070/ICIR 0.75, best of round; ret_vr_corr (alpha_0055) replaced alpha_0006 at 1.58x (first replacement executed, registry clean). The R5 cross-quantity-correlation lesson extends to the new flow fields.

successful_patterns.pattern: Event recency/frequency and conditional aggression keep minting on fresh quantities
successful_patterns.evidence: R6: amp_burst_rec (HighDay on AMP), vr_burst_freq (VR>2 count), aggr_hi_vr (close-vs-vwap on high-VR days), amp_selfrank all accepted. The trick portfolio: {count, recency, self-rank, conditional-mean} x {any new quantity}.

successful_patterns.pattern: Correlation constructs are band-separable, like reversal: quarterly versions of accepted 20d couplings clear the corr gate
successful_patterns.evidence: R7: ret_vr_corr60, attn_risk_corr60, lag_chase60 all accepted (OOS 0.038-0.044); med_band60 (quarterly median reversal) OOS 0.070, best of round. But the MF flavor failed: mf_ret_corr60 hit 0.76 vs its own 20d version — band separation works across most, not all, constructs.

successful_patterns.pattern: MF coupling extends to second price quantities: flow-range and flow-aggression correlations
successful_patterns.evidence: R7: mf_amp_corr (OOS 0.041) and mf_vwap_corr (OOS 0.048) accepted; mf_turn_corr and mf_gap_corr died at S1 — the coupling must involve a PRICE-action quantity, not another volume quantity.

successful_patterns.pattern: Burst-frequency and burst-recency are both mintable per quantity (aggression, VR, gaps)
successful_patterns.evidence: R7: aggr_burst_freq, vr_burst_rec, gap_burst_rec accepted (recencies at 2/3 universes — smaller-cap leaning).

successful_patterns.pattern: Interaction template scales: 6/8 accepted in one round when both parents are accepted behavioral factors from DIFFERENT families
successful_patterns.evidence: R8: medband x volclock, fragility x vrburst, limit x turnself, semivol x volclock, gapvol x maxfreq, ampself x medband all in (always negative = agreement bearish). The two failures were sub-universe fails (maxeff x lowturn, rsq x turnlow at 1/3) — interactions involving turn_low lean small-cap.

successful_patterns.pattern: Robust/median constructs are a first-class family: median bands, mean-median gaps, median gap drift, and MAX-of-aggression
successful_patterns.evidence: R8: gap_med60 (median overnight drift) OOS 0.051, mean_med_gap60 OOS 0.049, aggr_max (biggest close-vs-vwap push) OOS 0.083 — best of round; ret_amp_corr60 OOS 0.062. med_band120 died only at corr vs med_band60 (0.82) — one band per median construct.

successful_patterns.pattern: Band separation extends to RegBeta and remaining couplings (volresp60, lag2_60, aggr_attn_corr60 in; fragility60 died at the S4 OOS-ratio bar)
successful_patterns.evidence: R8: 5 more quarterly bands accepted. Also 2nd replacement executed: aggr_vr_corr displaced alpha_0042 at 0.84 corr.

successful_patterns.pattern: Robust/median family MVP confirmed: median daily range is the best OOS factor in the set
successful_patterns.evidence: R9: hl_med60 (-TsMed(HIGH/LOW-1, 60)) OOS 0.094 (set-wide best); id_med60 accepted (median intraday drift, reversal direction); aggr_min (deepest capitulation close) OOS 0.059; semivol60 replaced skew-based alpha_0008 at 0.83 corr (3rd replacement). But robust framing does NOT rescue dead quantities: ret_med60/aggr_med60/mf_med60 all S1, amp_med_dev 0.94 corr.

successful_patterns.pattern: Slow bands keep clearing: vol_term_slow, semivol60, mf coupling 60d bands, signed_vr60; anti-intuitive attention-void factor works
successful_patterns.evidence: R9: vol_term_slow (60/250) OOS 0.052, mf_vwap_corr60 0.051, mf_amp_corr60 0.036; flat_open_freq (count of no-gap opens = attention void) OOS -0.047 with direction -1: neglected-open names outperform.

successful_patterns.pattern: Interaction hit rate holds at scale (8/15) with two new failure signatures
successful_patterns.evidence: R9: 8 accepted. Failures: ix_medband_gapvol 1/3 universes; ix_ovnmom_vrburst year-rate 0.71 (first S4 year-consistency kill); 5 S1 fails all had a CORR-construct parent — interactions want simple-quantity parents, not correlation parents.

successful_patterns.pattern: What survives the 0.03 standard: median/robust, tails, vol shapes/terms, strong couplings + their bands, attention levels/clocks, band reversals
successful_patterns.evidence: 69 survivors incl. hl_med60 0.094, max_eff 0.091, gap_vol 0.085, aggr_max 0.083, turn_low 0.080, vol_clock 0.076, intr_mom60 0.072, semivol60 0.070, med_band60 0.070. Target these classes; probes below ~0.04 IS IC will die at the OOS bar half the time.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Sign-counting / path-only reversal (discarding magnitude)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: rev_path (-TsSum(Sign(RET),20)) ICIR 0.21 < 0.30, rejected S1. Magnitude information matters.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Book-to-price on full-A at 10d horizon
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: bp_ind ICIR 0.24, rejected S1 (EP passed instead). Stale book values don't cross-sectionally discriminate at short horizons.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Plain volatility/amplitude/idio-vol variants as standalone candidates
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: lowvol/amp_low/ivol died at dedup vs max_eff/turn_low. R2: vol_of_vol also died (corr 0.72 vs max_eff). The only vol construct that survived is the up/down SEMIVOL ASYMMETRY (alpha_0016, IS 0.062 -> OOS 0.067) — vol ideas must change the shape, not the scale.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Plain close-to-close 1-month reversal (incl. industry-neutralized)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: rev20 and rev20_ind died at dedup vs intraday_rev. The intraday leg is the purer carrier; don't re-propose whole-return reversal.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Over-saturating one family in a single round
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R1: 3 turnover factors + 3 volume-price factors accepted, several pairs near the 0.7 corr ceiling; marginal diversity per slot fell (set diversity 0.90). Cap ~2 candidates per family per round; the prompt explicitly lists over-saturation as a forbidden pattern.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Classic slow risk premia (beta, size shape, Amihud illiquidity) at the 10d horizon
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: low_beta ICIR 0.08, size_nl -0.26, amihud ICIR 0.18 (IC 0.027 but unstable) — all S1 rejects. These axes need the 20d+ label or portfolio-level treatment, not 10d cross-sections.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Price-path shape descriptors (trend residual, R-squared trendiness, return autocorrelation, close position in range)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: resi_trend 0.08, rsq_choppy -0.08, ret_autocorr -0.09, close_pos 0.12 ICIR — the whole path-shape family is dead at 10d on full-A.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Higher tail moments beyond MAX/skew (kurtosis) and TTM earnings momentum via PctChange
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: kurt ICIR -0.12 (max_eff+skew already span the tail); sue_ttm IC 0.018/cov 0.86 — TTM-delta earnings momentum too weak/slow; needs announcement-dated surprise, not rolling TTM drift.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Treating the demeaned-rank interaction template as universal
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R3: gapvol_x_turn passed S1-S3 but FAILED stage 4 with 1/3 sub-universes (full-A-only effect = small-cap artifact); semivol_x_cfp died at S1 (value parents don't interact). The template only worked for behavioral-flow parent pairs (R2). Require both parents behavioral AND check sub-universe robustness expectation before spending a slot.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Earnings momentum at the 10d horizon in ANY form (rolling TTM or announcement-dated revisions)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R2: sue_ttm failed S1. R3: earn_rev60 passed IS (0.022/0.34) but stage-4 showed OOS 2022-23 collapse to -0.003 with year_rate 0.57 — regime-dead post-2021, first true OOS kill of the pipeline. Fundamentals only survive as LEVELS (EP/CFP yields), not changes.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Composing two winning transforms and assuming the composition wins (gap x asymmetry), turnover distribution shape (skew), accruals and nominal price at 10d
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R3: gap_asym ICIR -0.04 (asymmetry does not transfer to the overnight leg); turn_skew 0.01; accruals 0.20; price_nominal 0.07; exp_growth 0.21 (express coverage 0.70 is usable but the signal is weak). leg_vol_ratio -0.31 also sub-gate.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Fundamental LEVELS beyond EP/CFP at the 10d horizon (quality is dead too)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R4: roe_ind 0.20, opmargin_ind 0.17, cash_ratio 0.09, low_leverage 0.00, sp_ind 0.25, fcfp_ind 0.24 ICIR — ALL S1 rejects. Revises the R2 'levels survive' lesson: only direct price yields (EP, CFP) clear the bar, and value timing (ep_tsrank) died at stage 4 (2/3 universes, OOS 0.010).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Management guidance (forecast midpoint) — regime-dead OOS like all earnings-linked signals
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R4: fc_mid passed IS (0.027/0.34, coverage 0.88 fine) but stage-4 OOS -0.011, year rate 0.57. The fundamentals-that-move family (momentum, revisions, guidance) is uniformly dead post-2021.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Monotone transforms / reaggregations of an accepted factor's core quantity (assume corr>0.7)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R4 S2 killed 9: outlier_habit~max_eff 0.78, ampresp_beta~turn_low 0.78, turn_conc~turn_cv 0.91, rev_skip~intraday_rev 0.89 (skip-window does NOT decorrelate), intraday_skew~skew 0.74 (leg lesson generalizes), upmove_share~intraday_rev 0.79, amp_spike~turn_spike 0.75, turn_trend~turn_spike 0.70, volresp_asym~volresp 0.74. Spend slots on new quantities, not new dressings.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Anchor/position constructs: 52w-high proximity, drawdown depth, open/vwap position in range, gap-fill tendency
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R4: hi52 ICIR 0.04 (cov 0.82 also thin), dd_depth 0.09, vwap_pos 0.02, open_pos -0.26 (under IC bar), gap_fade 0.08 — the whole where-is-price-relative-to-anchor family is dead, matching R2's close_pos.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Candle anatomy (shadows, body share) — the whole family is dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R5: upper_shadow 0.09, lower_shadow 0.26, shadow_asym 0.22, body_share 0.22 ICIR — all S1 rejects, like every other within-bar position construct (R2 close_pos, R4 vwap/open_pos).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Self-rank WITHIN the same construct and monotone shape variants (2nd confirmation wave)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R5 S2: amt_selfrank~turn_selfrank 0.96, pvcorr_selfrank~pv_corr 0.89, turn_medmean~turn_cv 0.75, cv_dispersion~turn_low 0.71, ret_on_hivol~semivol_asym 0.72 (the smart-money split is just semivol asymmetry in disguise), vol_share_up dup of signed_attn. Self-rank only works when applied to a DIFFERENT quantity than an accepted factor.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Seasonality echo, 1y whole-return band, listing age, days-since-low, overnight continuation, conditional splits by market state
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R5 S1: annual_echo -0.09, rev_1y 0.15 (cov 0.76 too), young_stock -0.04, lowday_close -0.24 under bar, overnight_contin -0.02, ret_on_mkt_tail 0.26, gap_x_vr -0.06, intr_on_downday -0.17, ret_on_lovol 0.18, down_elasticity -0.24, turn_trough_rec -0.23, rsq_turn 0.33 but IC 0.019, attn_rank_mom 0.17, limit_down_cnt 0.29.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Flow LEVELS and accumulation at the 10d horizon: moneyflow direction means, northbound deltas, margin balances
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R6 S1 slaughter: all 11 moneyflow level/mean/divergence/consistency constructs ICIR<=0.24 except the corr; all 7 northbound (hk_level 0.21, deltas 0.24-0.29 — close but under); all margin levels (rz_level -0.14, rz_net20 0.29). Institutional positioning is priced or too slow at 10d; only its interaction with price moves carries signal.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: TsCorr/TsStd on 0-filled eligibility fields (HK/RZ) — zero variance makes NaN and craters coverage
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R6: hk_ret_corr cov 0.42, rz_ret_corr cov 0.37 (S1 coverage fail regardless of signal). Eligible-subset signals need subset-level evaluation or level-safe operators; don't spend full-A slots on them.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: More than one representative per event TYPE (limit-board variants collapse together)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R6 S2: limit_close_cnt 0.87 and touch_no_close 0.73 vs alpha_0031 (limit_touch count) despite limit_close_cnt's stellar standalone IS 0.075/0.76; vr_std 0.80 vs turn_cv. One factor per event family.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Lead-lag flow correlations (flow leading returns, attention leading returns, flow chasing yesterday)
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R7: mf_lead -0.13, vr_lead -0.26 at S1; mf_lag_chase passed IS then died OOS (-0.001, year 0.86). Timing information in flows does not survive; only contemporaneous coupling styles do.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Crash-side FREQUENCY (min_freq) — tails are asymmetric: magnitude works on the down side, frequency only on the up side
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R7: min_freq ICIR 0.01 dead while max_freq (up) and min_eff (down magnitude) are both accepted factors.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Second representatives per quantity/event (7 more S2 kills), flow event structures beyond coupling
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R7 S2: vr_on_up~signed_attn 0.98, one_word_rec~one_word_cnt 0.89, mf_sm_ret_corr~mf_ret_corr 0.79 (mechanical mirror), intr_burst_freq~max_freq 0.77, mf_on_limit~limit_touch 0.77, signed_amp~intraday_rev 0.75. S1: all MF event/recency/self-rank constructs (mf_lg_rec ICIR 0.50 but IC 0.017 under bar — flows are too weak cross-sectionally for event tricks).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: HK/margin in ANY form at 10d full-A — levels, deltas, ind-neutral deltas, dip-buying conditionals, burst counts all dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R8 closed the book: hk_dip 0.02, hk_d20_ind 0.26, rz_burst -0.06, hk_burst 0.14 after R6's level slaughter and R7's corr-coverage trap. Northbound/margin need 20d+ horizons or subset universes — stop spending 10d full-A slots.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: New-high/new-low making frequency, conditional aggression splits, MF conditional sums
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R8 S1: lowmake_freq -0.23, himake_freq 0.19, aggr_on_down -0.24 (IC 0.034 but ICIR under), mf_on_shock 0.31/IC 0.016, gap_aggr_corr -0.01, ix parents from same quantity (ix_mfvwap_rev -0.44 but |IC| 0.015 under bar; ix_mineff_vrmean 0.14).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Flow (moneyflow) beyond contemporaneous price-action coupling — final verdict
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R9 closed it: mf_med60 0.22, mf_max -0.23, mf_dump_freq -0.20, mf_lg_med_dev -0.13 all S1. Across R6-R9 the ONLY flow survivors are TsCorr(MF_LG_NET, {RET, AMP, close/vwap}, {20,60}).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Interactions with correlation-construct parents; robust reframings of already-dead quantities
forbidden_patterns.evidence: R9: ix_retvr_medband, ix_mfret_gapvol, ix_lagchase_ampself all S1 (corr parents); doji_freq (freq rescue of dead body-share) -0.45 but |IC| 0.018 under, vwap_gap -0.02 (vwap-anchored gap adds nothing over close-anchored).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Under the 0.03 IC standard (2026-07-07): demeaned-rank interactions rarely clear the bar — deprioritize
forbidden_patterns.evidence: Purge removed 13 of 15 interactions (their |IC| clusters 0.02-0.045 with OOS mostly <0.03). Only spend interaction slots when BOTH parents have |IS IC| >= 0.05, and expect most to fail.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Under the 0.03 standard: event-recency (HighDay-of-quantity) constructs decay below the bar OOS
forbidden_patterns.evidence: Purged: amp_burst_rec (OOS 0.022), vr_burst_rec (0.015), gap_burst_rec (0.016), aggr_burst_rec (0.018), vol_peak_rec (0.015). Burst FREQUENCY holds; burst RECENCY doesn't.
